subject: Security

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: HTTPS redirection is only enabled in Development, not Production
findings.recommendation: Call webApp.UseHttpsRedirection() unconditionally (or at least in Production), not only when IsDevelopment() is true. As written, the environment where HTTPS enforcement matters most (Production) has it disabled, while it runs in Development where it is least needed.

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: No Content-Security-Policy header is configured

evidence.excerpt:
public static void ApiWebApplication(this WebApplication webApp)
{ ... webApp.OpenApiWebApplication(); webApp.LoggingWebApplication(); webApp.SwaggerWebApplication(); webApp.UseMiddleware<UnhandledExceptionMiddleware>(); webApp.MapControllers(); }

findings.standard: OWASP Content Security Policy Cheat Sheet
findings.recommendation: Add a Content-Security-Policy response header (e.g. via webApp.Use(async (ctx, next) => { ctx.Response.Headers["Content-Security-Policy"] = "default-src 'self'"; await next(); }) or a headers-policy middleware), avoiding unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval. Even for a JSON API, a restrictive CSP mitigates risk if any HTML/Swagger UI is served from the same origin.

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: No Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) header is configured

evidence.excerpt: public static void ApiWebApplication(this WebApplication webApp) { ... } // no webApp.UseHsts() call anywhere in the pipeline

findings.recommendation: Call webApp.UseHsts() for non-Development environments (typically alongside a corrected, unconditional UseHttpsRedirection()) so browsers are instructed to only use HTTPS for subsequent requests.

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: No X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff header is configured

evidence.excerpt: public static void ApiWebApplication(this WebApplication webApp) { ... } // no security-headers middleware or explicit header set

findings.recommendation: Add X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff to every response, e.g. via a small response-header middleware registered early in ApiWebApplication, to prevent MIME-sniffing attacks.

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: No clickjacking protection header (X-Frame-Options / frame-ancestors) is configured

evidence.excerpt: public static void ApiWebApplication(this WebApplication webApp) { ... } // no X-Frame-Options or frame-ancestors directive set

findings.recommendation: Set X-Frame-Options: DENY (or SAMEORIGIN) or a frame-ancestors CSP directive on responses to block clickjacking via iframe embedding, particularly for any Swagger/OpenAPI UI served by this app.

strengths.title: Global exception handling returns a generic, correlation-ID-based message without stack traces or internal details
